sourceStatement: STAGE 自撰题目卡，基于公开考试大纲的话题分类与题型结构；不含任何第三方题库的逐字内容。

topics.sourceNote: 自撰，基于公开大纲话题分类

questions.textEn: Where is your hometown?
What do you like most about the place where you grew up?
Has your hometown changed much since you were a child?
Would you like to live in your hometown in the future?
Is your hometown a good place for young people?
What would you show a visitor who only had one day there?
Describe a place in your hometown that you often take visitors to.
cuePointsEn: And explain why you take people to this place

questions.textEn: Describe a change you would like to see in your hometown.
cuePointsEn: Why you think it is needed
And explain how you think it could happen

questions.textEn: Why do people move away from the places where they grew up?
questions.glossZh: 问的是普遍原因，不是你自己的经历。

questions.textEn: How does the size of a town change the way people live in it?
Should old buildings be protected when a city needs more space?
questions.glossZh: 取舍类问题：保护与发展之间怎么权衡。

topics.sourceNote: 自撰，基于公开大纲话题分类

questions.textEn: Do you work, or are you a student?
What do you enjoy most about your work or your studies?
Is there anything you would change about your working day?
Do you prefer to work in the morning or later in the day?
Do you work better on your own or with other people?
What job did you want to do when you were a child?
Describe a task you found difficult but finished anyway.
cuePointsEn: When you had to do it
And explain how you felt when it was done

questions.textEn: Describe a skill you learned for your work or your studies.
cuePointsEn: And explain how you use it now

questions.textEn: Why do some people change careers in the middle of their lives?
questions.glossZh: 谈中年转行的动因，可从个人与外部环境两面说。

questions.textEn: What makes one workplace better to be in than another?
Will most people still go to an office in twenty years' time?

topics.sourceNote: 自撰，基于公开大纲话题分类

questions.textEn: What time do you usually get up?
Is your daily routine the same every day?
Which part of the day do you like best?
Do you plan your day in advance, or decide as you go?
Has your routine changed in the last few years?
Is there anything you always do before you go to bed?
Describe a part of your daily routine that you enjoy.
cuePointsEn: And explain why you enjoy it

questions.textEn: Describe a day when your usual routine was completely changed.
cuePointsEn: And explain how you felt about the day

questions.textEn: Why do some people keep the same routine for years?
questions.glossZh: 问的是稳定作息带来的好处或心理原因。

questions.textEn: Is a fixed routine helpful, or does it stop people trying new things?
questions.glossZh: 两面讨论题，答案需要给出立场并说明理由。

questions.textEn: How has the way people organise their day changed compared with their parents' generation?

topics.sourceNote: 自撰，基于公开大纲话题分类

questions.textEn: What kind of food do you usually eat?
Do you cook at home?
Did you learn to cook from anyone in your family?
Do you prefer eating at home or eating out?
Is there any food you disliked as a child but like now?
What is a dish that is common where you live?
Describe a meal you enjoyed cooking or eating with other people.
cuePointsEn: And explain why you remember it

questions.textEn: Describe a food that is popular in your country.
cuePointsEn: And explain why you think it is popular

questions.textEn: Why do eating habits change when people move to another country?
questions.glossZh: 可以从可获得的食材、时间安排、社交场合等角度说。

questions.textEn: Are family meals less common than they used to be?
Should schools teach children how to cook?

topics.sourceNote: 自撰，基于公开大纲话题分类

questions.textEn: What is the weather like where you live?
Which season do you like best?
Does the weather change what you do at the weekend?
Do you prefer hot weather or cold weather?
Do you check the weather forecast?
Is there a kind of weather you find difficult?
Describe a day when the weather changed your plans.
cuePointsEn: And explain how you felt about it

questions.textEn: Describe a season or a time of year you look forward to.
cuePointsEn: What the weather is like then
And explain why you look forward to it

questions.textEn: How does weather affect the way people feel?
questions.glossZh: 问的是天气与情绪、作息的关系。

questions.textEn: Why do people in different regions have such different attitudes to rain?
Should cities be designed differently for hotter summers?
questions.glossZh: 城市规划类问题：可以谈绿化、遮阳、建筑材料等。

topics.sourceNote: 自撰，基于公开大纲话题分类

questions.textEn: How do you usually travel around your city?
How long does it take you to get to work or to your school?
Do you enjoy the journey, or is it just something you have to do?
Have the transport options where you live improved?
Do you ever walk or cycle instead?
What do you usually do while you are travelling?
Describe a journey you make regularly.
cuePointsEn: And explain how you feel about making it

questions.textEn: Describe a time when a journey took much longer than you expected.
cuePointsEn: What you did while you waited

questions.textEn: Why do some people prefer driving even when public transport is available?
questions.glossZh: 谈选择背后的原因：时间、舒适度、习惯等。

questions.textEn: What makes people willing to walk or cycle more?
How should a city decide where to build new transport links?
questions.glossZh: 问的是决策依据，不是具体线路。

topics.sourceNote: 自撰，基于公开大纲话题分类

questions.textEn: What piece of technology do you use most?
How often do you change your phone or your computer?
Do you find new devices easy to learn?
Do you use technology more for work or for entertainment?
Is there any technology you have decided not to use?
Who taught you to use the devices you own?
Describe a piece of technology that made your life easier.
cuePointsEn: And explain how it changed things for you

questions.textEn: Describe a time when a device stopped working when you needed it.
Why do some people feel uneasy about new technology?
questions.glossZh: 谈不安的来源：学习成本、隐私、可靠性等。

questions.textEn: Does having more devices actually save people time?
questions.glossZh: 反直觉类问题，需要给出立场并举例支撑。

questions.textEn: How should children's use of screens be managed?

topics.sourceNote: 自撰，基于公开大纲话题分类

questions.textEn: What kind of music do you listen to?
When do you usually listen to music?
Have you ever learned a musical instrument?
Has the music you like changed since you were younger?
Do you prefer listening at home or hearing music live?
Is music important in your family?
Describe a song or a piece of music that means something to you.
cuePointsEn: And explain why it matters to you

questions.textEn: Describe a live performance you attended.
cuePointsEn: And explain what you remember most about it

questions.textEn: Why does music from a particular period stay popular for so long?
questions.glossZh: 谈某个年代的音乐为什么经久不衰。

questions.textEn: Should children be taught to play an instrument at school?
How has the way people find new music changed?

topics.sourceNote: 自撰，基于公开大纲话题分类

questions.textEn: Do you play any sports?
How often do you exercise?
Did you enjoy sport at school?
Do you prefer team sports or exercising on your own?
Do you watch sport on television?
Is there a sport you would like to try?
Describe a sport or an activity you enjoy doing.
cuePointsEn: And explain why you enjoy it

questions.textEn: Describe a time you kept going with something physical that was hard.
cuePointsEn: And explain how you felt afterwards

questions.textEn: Why do many adults stop exercising after they leave school?
questions.glossZh: 谈成年后运动量下降的原因。

questions.textEn: Should local governments pay for sports facilities?
questions.glossZh: 公共支出类问题：谁受益、钱从哪来。

questions.textEn: What makes a sport popular in one country and not in another?

topics.sourceNote: 自撰，基于公开大纲话题分类

questions.textEn: Do you read much?
What sort of things do you read?
Do you read on paper or on a screen?
When do you usually find time to read?
Did you enjoy reading as a child?
Do you ever recommend books to other people?
Describe a book or an article you found useful.
cuePointsEn: And explain why it was useful to you

questions.textEn: Describe something you read that changed how you thought about a subject.
cuePointsEn: And explain what changed for you

questions.textEn: Why do fewer people read long texts now?
questions.glossZh: 谈长文阅读减少的原因，可从注意力与媒介两面说。

questions.textEn: Do people remember things differently when they read on a screen?
questions.glossZh: 对比纸质与屏幕阅读的记忆效果。

questions.textEn: How can reading be encouraged among young people?

topics.sourceNote: 自撰，基于公开大纲话题分类

questions.textEn: Do you enjoy shopping?
Do you shop online or in shops?
How often do you buy clothes?
Do you make a list before you shop?
Do you prefer shopping alone or with someone?
Is there a shop near you that you go to often?
Describe something you bought that you were pleased with.
cuePointsEn: And explain why you were pleased with it

questions.textEn: Describe a time you spent a long time deciding what to buy.
cuePointsEn: And explain whether you were happy with the choice

questions.textEn: Why do people buy things they do not really need?
questions.glossZh: 谈消费动机，不必只讲广告。

questions.textEn: Have small local shops become less important?
How does advertising change what people buy?

topics.sourceNote: 自撰，基于公开大纲话题分类

questions.textEn: How many hours do you usually sleep?
Do you go to bed at the same time every night?
Do you ever sleep during the day?
What helps you sleep well?
Has your sleep changed over the years?
Do you use an alarm to wake up?
Describe a habit that helps you rest well.
cuePointsEn: And explain how it helps you

questions.textEn: Describe a time when you were very tired.
cuePointsEn: And explain how you felt the next day

questions.textEn: Why do many people get less sleep than they need?
questions.glossZh: 谈睡眠不足的普遍原因。

questions.textEn: Should workplaces pay attention to how well their staff rest?
questions.glossZh: 问的是雇主责任的边界。

questions.textEn: How do modern habits affect the way people sleep?

topics.sourceNote: 自撰，基于公开大纲话题分类

questions.textEn: How often do you see your friends?
Where did you meet most of your friends?
Do you prefer a large group of friends or a few close ones?
What do you usually do together?
Is it easy to make friends as an adult?
Do you keep in touch with friends from school?
Describe a friend you have known for a long time.
cuePointsEn: And explain why the friendship has lasted

questions.textEn: Describe a time a friend helped you.
cuePointsEn: And explain what it meant to you

questions.textEn: Why do some friendships last for decades while others fade?
questions.glossZh: 对比两类友谊的差别，谈维系的条件。

questions.textEn: Has technology changed what friendship means?
questions.glossZh: 问的是友谊的定义是否变了，不只是联系方式。

questions.textEn: Are friends more important than family in some situations?

topics.sourceNote: 自撰，基于公开大纲话题分类

questions.textEn: What do you usually do in your free time?
Do you have more free time now than a few years ago?
Do you prefer to spend free time indoors or outdoors?
Do you plan your weekends?
Is there a hobby you would like to take up?
Do you spend free time alone or with other people?
Describe an activity you took up recently.
cuePointsEn: And explain what you get out of it

questions.textEn: Describe a weekend you enjoyed.
cuePointsEn: And explain why you enjoyed it

questions.textEn: Why do some people find it hard to relax?
questions.glossZh: 谈放松困难的原因，可从工作节奏与心理习惯两面说。

questions.textEn: Has the amount of free time people have changed over the years?
Should employers care what their staff do outside work?
questions.glossZh: 问的是工作与私人生活的界限。

topics.sourceNote: 自撰，基于公开大纲话题分类

questions.textEn: Do you have a pet, or have you had one?
Are pets common where you live?
Did you like animals when you were a child?
Do you enjoy visiting places where you can see animals?
Are there many birds or animals in your neighbourhood?
Would you like to work with animals?
Describe an animal you find interesting.
cuePointsEn: And explain why you find it interesting

questions.textEn: Describe a time you looked after an animal.
cuePointsEn: And explain how you felt about it

questions.textEn: Why do people keep pets in cities?
questions.glossZh: 谈城市养宠的动机与条件。

questions.textEn: Should wild spaces near cities be left alone?
questions.glossZh: 开发与保留之间的取舍。

questions.textEn: How do attitudes to animals differ between generations?

topics.sourceNote: 自撰，基于公开大纲话题分类

questions.textEn: What kind of clothes do you usually wear?
Do you dress differently for work and for the weekend?
Do you enjoy buying clothes?
Has your taste in clothes changed?
Do you follow what is fashionable?
Do you keep clothes for a long time?
Describe an item of clothing you wear often.
cuePointsEn: And explain why you wear it so often

questions.textEn: Describe an occasion when you had to dress in a particular way.
Why do people in some jobs wear a uniform?
questions.glossZh: 谈制服的作用：辨识、安全、平等等。

questions.textEn: Does what people wear affect how they are treated?
questions.glossZh: 问的是着装与他人判断之间的关系。

questions.textEn: How quickly do clothing styles change now compared with the past?

topics.sourceNote: 自撰，基于公开大纲话题分类

questions.textEn: Do you take many photographs?
What do you usually photograph?
Do you prefer taking photos or being in them?
Do you look back at old photographs?
Do you print photos, or keep them on a device?
Has the way you take photos changed?
Describe a photograph you like.
cuePointsEn: And explain why you like it

questions.textEn: Describe a time you wanted to take a photograph but could not.
Why do people photograph so much of their daily lives now?
questions.glossZh: 谈随手拍照成为习惯的原因。

questions.textEn: Does taking photographs change how people experience an event?
questions.glossZh: 问的是记录行为本身对体验的影响。

questions.textEn: Should there be limits on photographing people in public?

topics.sourceNote: 自撰，基于公开大纲话题分类

questions.textEn: Do you travel much?
Where did you go on your last trip?
Do you prefer travelling alone or with others?
How do you decide where to go?
Do you plan trips in detail?
Would you rather visit a new place or return to one you know?
Describe a trip you enjoyed.
cuePointsEn: And explain why you enjoyed it

questions.textEn: Describe a place you would like to visit.
cuePointsEn: And explain why you want to go

questions.textEn: Why has travelling become more common than it was fifty years ago?
questions.glossZh: 谈成本、交通、信息等条件的变化。

questions.textEn: Does tourism help or harm the places people visit?
questions.glossZh: 两面题：需要给出立场并举例。

questions.textEn: What can people learn from spending time in another country?

topics.sourceNote: 自撰，基于公开大纲话题分类

questions.textEn: Do you know your neighbours?
What is your neighbourhood like?
Is it quiet where you live?
What facilities are near your home?
Would you like to move somewhere else?
Has your area changed recently?
Describe a place near your home that you go to often.
cuePointsEn: And explain why you go there

questions.textEn: Describe a neighbour you get on well with.
cuePointsEn: And explain why you get on

questions.textEn: Why do people in cities often not know their neighbours?
questions.glossZh: 谈城市生活方式对邻里关系的影响。

questions.textEn: What makes a neighbourhood a good place to live?
Should local people decide what gets built near them?
questions.glossZh: 问的是决策权归属，可谈利弊。

topics.sourceNote: 自撰，基于公开大纲话题分类

questions.textEn: How long have you been learning English?
Do you speak any other languages?
What do you find hardest about learning a language?
Where do you practise speaking?
Do you enjoy learning languages?
Do you use English outside your studies?
Describe a time you used a foreign language outside the classroom.
Describe a way of learning that works well for you.
cuePointsEn: And explain why it works for you

questions.textEn: Why do some people learn languages faster than others?
questions.glossZh: 谈个体差异的来源：环境、方法、动机等。

questions.textEn: Will fewer people learn languages as translation tools improve?
questions.glossZh: 预测类问题，需要说明理由。

questions.textEn: What is lost when a language stops being spoken?
questions.glossZh: 谈语言消失带来的文化损失。

topics.sourceNote: 自撰，基于公开大纲话题分类

questions.textEn: What celebrations are important where you live?
How do you usually celebrate your birthday?
Do you enjoy large gatherings?
Do you give presents on special occasions?
Have the ways people celebrate changed since you were a child?
Is there a celebration you look forward to?
Describe a celebration you took part in.
cuePointsEn: And explain what you remember about it

questions.textEn: Describe a gift you gave or received.
cuePointsEn: Who it was from or for
And explain why it stayed in your memory

questions.textEn: Why do public celebrations matter to a community?
questions.glossZh: 谈集体庆祝的社会作用。

questions.textEn: Are traditional festivals losing their meaning?
questions.glossZh: 问的是意义是否被稀释，可给出双面看法。

questions.textEn: Should companies be involved in public celebrations?

topics.sourceNote: 自撰，基于公开大纲话题分类

questions.textEn: Do you visit museums or galleries?
Did you do art at school?
Do you have any pictures on your walls at home?
Would you like to learn to draw or paint?
Are museums popular where you live?
Do you prefer older art or modern art?
Describe a museum or gallery you have visited.
cuePointsEn: And explain what you thought of it

questions.textEn: Describe a work of art you remember.
cuePointsEn: And explain why you remember it

questions.textEn: Why should public money be spent on museums?
questions.glossZh: 公共投入类问题：谈价值与受益者。

questions.textEn: Does art need to be understood to be enjoyed?
questions.glossZh: 问的是理解与欣赏之间的关系。

questions.textEn: How can museums make their collections interesting to young people?

topics.sourceNote: 自撰，基于公开大纲话题分类

questions.textEn: Do you spend much time outdoors?
Are there parks near where you live?
Do you keep any plants at home?
Did you grow anything as a child?
Do you prefer the countryside or the city?
Is there a natural place you like to visit?
Describe a natural place you enjoy being in.
cuePointsEn: And explain how it makes you feel

questions.textEn: Describe a plant or a tree that is common where you live.
cuePointsEn: And explain why people notice it

questions.textEn: Why do people feel better after time outdoors?
questions.glossZh: 谈户外活动与身心状态的关系。

questions.textEn: Should cities have more green space, even if land is expensive?
questions.glossZh: 成本与收益的取舍题。

questions.textEn: How can ordinary people help protect the natural world?

topics.sourceNote: 自撰，基于公开大纲话题分类

questions.textEn: Do you keep track of what you spend?
Did you save money as a child?
Do you prefer to save or to spend?
Do you use cash or a card?
Do you plan large purchases in advance?
Who taught you about money?
Describe something you saved up for.
cuePointsEn: And explain how you felt when you got it

questions.textEn: Describe a decision about money that you thought carefully about.
cuePointsEn: And explain how it turned out

questions.textEn: Why do people find saving money difficult?
questions.glossZh: 谈储蓄困难的原因，可从收入与习惯两面说。

questions.textEn: Should personal finance be taught in schools?
questions.glossZh: 教育内容取舍类问题。

questions.textEn: How has the way people pay for things changed?

topics.sourceNote: 自撰，基于公开大纲话题分类

questions.textEn: What subjects did you enjoy at school?
Was there a teacher you remember well?
Do you prefer studying alone or in a class?
Do you take courses outside your main studies?
How do you keep learning now?
Do you like taking tests?
Describe a teacher who had an effect on you.
cuePointsEn: And explain what effect they had on you

questions.textEn: Describe something you learned outside school.
cuePointsEn: And explain why you wanted to learn it

questions.textEn: Why do people continue studying after they start working?
questions.glossZh: 谈在职学习的动机。

questions.textEn: Should schools focus more on practical skills?
questions.glossZh: 课程取舍类问题：实用技能与学科知识的平衡。

questions.textEn: How well can a written test show what someone knows?
questions.glossZh: 问的是评价方式的局限。

topics.sourceNote: 自撰，基于公开大纲话题分类

questions.textEn: Do you live in a house or a flat?
What do you like about where you live?
Would you like to live in a big city?
Are there any buildings you admire?
Is your city crowded?
What would make your city better?
Describe a building you find impressive.
cuePointsEn: And explain why you find it impressive

questions.textEn: Describe a place in a city where people like to spend time.
cuePointsEn: And explain why it attracts people

questions.textEn: Why do people keep moving to large cities?
questions.glossZh: 谈人口向大城市集中的原因。

questions.textEn: What problems come with cities growing quickly?
Should new buildings match the style of older ones around them?
questions.glossZh: 城市风貌类问题：统一与多样的取舍。
